eyebrow.zh: 找出出错步骤 · 而非出错提交 · 为编码智能体而生
eyebrow.en: Find the bad step · Not the bad commit · For coding agents

headline.zh: 精准定位你的编码智能体在哪一步走偏
headline.en: Find exactly where your coding agent went wrong

sub.zh: 将失败运行与同一任务的成功运行逐步对齐，精确定位两者分道扬镳的那一步。
sub.en: Line up your failed run against a passing run of the same task, step by step, and pinpoint the exact step where they parted ways.

title.en: The one step that broke it

body.zh: 别再肉眼比对几百个步骤。成功运行与失败运行首次分叉的那一步，几乎总是最该深究的——几秒内呈现在你面前。
body.en: Stop scanning two hundred steps by eye. The first step where a passing run and a failing run parted ways is almost always the one worth staring at — and it's handed to you in seconds.

chips: › first divergence, not the whole diff

title.zh: 绝不把两个不同任务拿来比对

body.zh: 在对齐之前，先比对两次运行的工作目录、分支与原始请求——一旦指向不同任务的运行，立刻提醒你。
body.en: Before any alignment, the working directory, branch, and original request of both runs are compared — so you're warned the instant you point it at runs that aren't the same task.

body.zh: 两次运行并排渲染，分叉处高亮——一眼看清分叉，无需在两份日志间来回对照。
body.en: Both runs render next to each other, the divergence lit up — so a human sees the fork in one glance instead of cross-referencing two logs.

body.zh: 用 npx 指向两份会话记录，本地页面随即打开。无云端、无账号、无上传——你的智能体会话记录绝不离开本机。
body.en: Point npx at two transcripts and a local page opens. No cloud, no account, no upload — your agent transcripts never leave your machine.
